proposals.rationale: Add companion exception qualifying C0002 for alcohol that is manifested and transported as part of a shipment, establishing an explicit exception to the possession prohibition.
proposals.quote: (i) Manifested and transported as part of a shipment; or

scope_quotes: However, this does not apply to possession of wine, beer, or distilled spirits which are:
fields.scope_text: When wine, beer, or distilled spirits are manifested and transported as part of a shipment.
fields.summary: The prohibition against possessing wine, beer, or distilled spirits while on duty or operating a commercial motor vehicle does not apply if the alcohol is manifested and transported as part of a shipment.

proposals.rationale: Add companion exception qualifying C0002 for alcohol that is possessed or used by bus passengers, establishing an explicit exception to the possession prohibition.
